title: Unit Event — The Vivid Old Tale — Episode8 City Lights

meta.Event Outline: After successfully hosting their own event for the first time, Vivid BAD SQUAD is determined to ride that wave closer to the heights of RAD WEEKEND. As they're discussing that legendary event, the members start to want to know more about Nagi, the woman who played a central role.

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...is what happened.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Kohane
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Nagi was so cool!
She went to rescue you from that construction site like a superhero!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
She sounded so amazing! And really reliable!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, she did.
Your story gave us a very clear picture of what she's like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she seems like a really good person. I guess you've gotta be to sing alongside Ken and Taiga.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, your past self probably wouldn't believe that you ended up enrolling in the school you snuck into that time...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, An, I vaguely remember hearing something about you being afraid of ghosts... Is that because...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, well... That's not important!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, I suppose so.
You can tell us all about it later!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we don't have to talk about it at all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In any case, it was nice to finally hear more about Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I understand now that she's very similar to you, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Similar to me?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A-Are you sure...?
She always seemed so much cooler and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the very least, she had a big influence on you growing up, right? That's what I took away from your story.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess she did...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even now, I feel like I'm chasing after trying to become a cool lady like her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Especially since she was the one who made me realize just how much I love everyone around town.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And how I want to learn to love this city even more...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Learn to love...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This city... Even more, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong, you two?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not wrong, but... That reminded me of something Tono said when we talked the other day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What did it remind you of...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What Taiga said to Tono after he lost to him in a battle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He said, “Take a look at this city.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Take a look at the city...?
What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono doesn't seem to know and neither do we... It's a total mystery...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Uncle Taiga said that to Arata?!
The city...? This city...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, Taiga told me the same thing when I was practicing with him...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He did?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. We even took walks around Vivid Street together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... So Taiga believes that we need to at least “take a look at this city” if we actually wish to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what exactly are we supposed to be looking for...? I doubt he meant just literally looking at stuff around town.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. Based on what you've all said, physically looking seems to be a small part of a bigger picture.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Well, you can find live houses and record stores... Is there anything else that comes to mind?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Other than those things...? People, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This may just be me, but everyone in Vivid Street's really friendly and loves music...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But if they weren't like that, we'd probably be talking about a pretty different place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah... I have to agree based on your story, An.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hang on. What does knowing what everyone's like have to do with music?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not really sure, but Taiga talks about those kinds of “practices” a lot so they must be related somehow...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what if you're supposed to put on an event and invite all the locals to be in the audience?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Didn't they do precisely that during their last event?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we did. Some weren't from Vivid Street, but most were local residents or musicians who've been performing there for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, that's not the answer...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, “taking a look at this city” does seem really important...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi also cared a lot about everyone around town...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Very true...
Let's keep doing our best to unravel this enigma...

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it's getting pretty late...!
We've been brainstorming for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we have. We should head home soon before we all get scolded.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At least we won't have the police coming after us like An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was that really necessary?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Hey, An!
How's it going?

rows.Speaker: Veteran Staff
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone. Welcome back.
I heard that the last VBS event was a huge hit. Way to go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You should both come see us next time! Oh, or should we just have here be our next venue?♪

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
That'd be great!
Our place can be the site of your very own legend!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everybody loves An so much.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Uh oh...!
Sorry, I really need to get home soon or else my dad's going to start worrying!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. Why don't we call things here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
See you guys later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, everyone! Bye bye!
We'll see you guys later too!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, welcome back. You were out pretty late today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! On top of practicing, we spent a lot of time discussing our next event and talking about all sorts of other stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I even got to tell Kohane and the others about Aunt Nagi today.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: About Nagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. They all seem to believe that she was central to making RAD WEEKEND what it was.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I mean, I know all three of you were key figures, but the way Aunt Nagi kicked things off left a huge impression on everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Her first song left me totally stunned too!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A few questions later, I was telling them a story about Aunt Nagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Remember when I was still in elementary school and ran away? I told them about how she found me that time!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I remember.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. The worried look I saw on your face that time made me so happy too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It felt really rare because you always seem so calm and collected, Dad!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hold on.
I worry about things just like anyone else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Are you sure about that?
I haven't seen you like that ever since...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After telling everyone about Aunt Nagi, I was told that I'm a lot like her... What do you think? Am I?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really hope that I have made some progress since I've sorta been chasing after her...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You and Nagi...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, you two are alike...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We are?
Hehe. Hearing that from you makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna keep doing my best to be like Aunt Nagi in order to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm not sure how I feel about you becoming that relentless...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, An, we shouldn't be getting any more customers, so can you start locking up for me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, sure!
I'll switch the sign to closed!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, the plate's flipped...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh wow... The sky's so clear tonight!
And the stars look so pretty!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The city lights seem even prettier for some reason. Why is that?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Through the eyes of someone not from here, this place can seem pretty rough or dangerous.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: They all care about you just this much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Maybe it's because I know everyone from around town's here...and doing their best...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What are you up to right now in America, Aunt Nagi? I really wish you'd send a message or something every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I can send her one!
That might take her by surprise!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna tell her all about the others, the events we've been doing and lots more...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna do everything I can for our next event! I'm gonna make it so I stun her the next time she sees me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They all seem to believe that Nagi was central to making RAD WEEKEND what it was.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (The time to tell them appears to be fast approaching...)
